title: bellwether case
description: One fixture line: a case plus the reference result, each second reference's and each witness's.

allOf.description: a parse line whose reference records the case carries the output's token ids and the text each one contributes
a round-trip parse line whose reference records the case says which stop id ends its output
a line whose reference does not record the case is written for its second references, and carries none of the reference's output
a parse line's second reference that records the case carries the token ids and pieces of its own output, and from the round trip the stop id that ends it

model.description: Hugging Face model id; the manifest pins the revision

request.description: render: an OpenAI chat completion request body

tools.description: parse: the tool definitions the output was produced with

output_ids.description: parse, detokenize: the engine output token ids

output_pieces.description: parse: the text each output token contributes under the reference tokenizer's incremental decode; one per id, joined they are the reference text

malformed.description: parse: output has no well-formed parse; verdict is policy, not regression

chunk_plans.description: name -> chunk lengths; null means the plan is derived (whole, per_token)

end_of_turn.description: parse, roundtrip: the stop id the template writes where the turn ends when it is the last message, in the turn (found_by turn) or opening the next message (found_by next-message); the output ends before it

provenance.description: oracle versions, HF revision, vendor file sha, bellwether commit

second_references.description: render, parse: the case through the reference's oracle with each tool chat template from vLLM's examples/ that vLLM's docs name for the checkpoint (src/bellwether/record/vllm_tool_templates.toml), in place of its own template; keyed by the template's file name

source.description: the reference's oracle for the kind: hf-template for render, roundtrip for parse

text.description: render: the prompt text; parse: the output text

ids.description: parse: the output token ids this template gives

pieces.description: parse: the text each output token contributes, as output_pieces

provenance.description: the template's vLLM commit and sha256, oracle versions, HF revision, bellwether commit

rejected.description: why the oracle refuses the case; it records no result

not_applicable.description: parse: why the case cannot apply to the template (it renders no tool calls); it records no result

records_the_case.description: a reference with a result: it gives no reason for recording none
